attributes.title: 2027 AANN Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANN Annual Conference takes place March 13 to 16, 2027, at The Westin Seattle. Pre-conference sessions are on March 13 and the main program starts March 14. It is an in-person meeting, with recorded sessions available afterwards.

AANN says attendees can earn up to 15 CE contact hours, including pharmacology hours. Registration opens in November 2026; registering before the early-bird deadline of February 24, 2027, saves $100, and groups of five or more from one facility get 10% off the base fee. Base rates have not been published yet.
